meta.title: A vendor cannot call any buyer write endpoint
gaps: the plan has the vendor send PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}, but the supplier app may not call PATCH /event_groups/:id (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
the plan has the vendor send POST /proposal, but the supplier app may not call POST /proposal (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
Vendor create event is not fully expressible because create_draft requires productUuid and productQualityUuid values not provided by the vocabulary.
Vendor stage creation is not expressible because add_rfq_round and add_rfp_round are buyer-only operations.
close_bid is not available as an operation.
warnings: error code 455 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The invited QA vendor updates the event.
The invited QA vendor sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
